# Elitez FMCG

> Singapore's most deployed FMCG field-marketing team — 300+ trained promoters for brand activations, supermarket merchandising and live sales tracking via BLINK. Operated by Elitez Group of Companies.

## What it is
- Field-marketing and brand-activation agency: promoter deployment, in-store sampling, supermarket merchandising and roadshows across Singapore.
- 300+ trained promoters deployable weekly, with live sales/activity tracking via the BLINK platform.

- [About](https://fmcg.elitez.asia/pages/about.html): Elitez FMCG track record and clients.
- [Contact](https://fmcg.elitez.asia/pages/contact.html): request a deployment quote.
